commands.label: Close Slice to New MIDI Track
commands.summary: Closes the Slice to New MIDI Track dialog.

commands.label: Create Clip
commands.summary: Puts a new clip on an audio or MIDI track's arrangement lane, at `clip.start` for `clip.length` ticks (705,600 to the quarter note).

commands.label: Create Clip in Slot
commands.summary: Puts a clip in a track's Session slot at `scene`, as Insert Empty MIDI Clip (Cmd+Shift+M) and dropping a clip in a slot do.

commands.label: Crop Clip
commands.raised_by_arguments: destructive as well when it would place clips over others, deleting or shortening them, so it then asks the person first unless you're autonomous; a dry run says which
commands.summary: Crops a clip to the part of it that plays, or to a span of song time: an audio clip's region is written as a new, shorter file and the clip plays it, with its Start and End markers, loop brace, and warp markers moved back so it plays exactly what it played before; a MIDI clip loses the notes that start outside the region, and writes no file.

commands.label: Crop Clip to Region
commands.summary: Crops a clip to a region of its contents: an audio clip plays the file `media` names, whose frames are the region of its old file's audio, and a MIDI clip loses the notes that start outside the region, writing no file.

commands.label: Crop Clip to Span
commands.summary: Crops a clip to a span of song time: its edges move to the span, and it plays the part of itself the span covered, at the same moments.

commands.label: Clip Defaults
commands.summary: Reads the defaults saved for an audio clip's file by `clip.save_default`: its `file`, the `<sample file name>.beatlayer-clip` beside the sample, and the `defaults` in it, or `null` when none are saved or the file does not hold settings for this content.

commands.label: Delete Clip
commands.summary: Deletes a clip, from the Arrangement or from a track's Session slot.

commands.label: Clear Envelope
commands.summary: Deletes a clip's envelope for a parameter, as Clear Envelope in the Envelopes tab does: the parameter goes back to what it does without the clip envelope.

commands.label: Delete Envelope Breakpoint
commands.summary: Deletes one of a clip envelope's breakpoints, so the segments either side of it become the one starting at the breakpoint before it, as clicking a breakpoint in the Envelopes tab does.

commands.label: Delete Transients
commands.summary: Takes transients out of an audio clip: `times` are their times in the file, in seconds, as `clip.transients` lists them.

commands.label: Delete Warp Markers
commands.summary: Deletes the warp markers named in `markers` (their place in the map, the first being 0) of each of the warped audio clips `clips`, which must hold files of the same length: the segments either side of each join into one straight segment.

commands.label: Edit Sample
commands.summary: Opens an audio clip's file in the external sample editor, as the Edit button in the Clip View's Audio Utilities panel does: the editor the File & Folder page's Sample Editor row names, or that page itself when it names none.

commands.label: Insert Transient
commands.summary: Puts a transient into an audio clip at `time`, seconds in its file: Insert Transient, at the Sample Editor's insert marker when the app runs it.

commands.label: Insert Warp Marker
commands.summary: Adds a warp marker to each of the warped audio clips `clips`, which must hold files of the same length: at a `beat` of the clip's contents (ticks from its 1.1.1, negative before it), at the time in the file the map already places there, or at a `time` in the file (seconds), on the beat the map already places it.

commands.label: Insert Warp Markers
commands.summary: Puts warp markers in a range of a warped audio clip's contents, `from` to `to` (ticks from the clip's 1.1.1): at every transient of the clip in the range, or, when it holds none, at its start and its end.

commands.label: Move Clip
commands.summary: Moves a clip so it starts at `start`, on the same track or another track of the same kind (audio or MIDI).

commands.label: Move Clips
commands.summary: Moves several clips earlier or later by the same number of ticks, keeping them on their tracks and keeping their spacing; a negative `by` moves them earlier.

commands.label: Move Envelope Breakpoint
commands.summary: Moves one of a clip envelope's breakpoints from `at` to `to`, as dragging it in the Envelopes tab does.

commands.label: Move Clip to Slot
commands.summary: Moves a clip into a track's Session slot at `scene`, out of the slot or the Arrangement lane it sits in, as dragging a clip between slots does.

commands.label: Move Transient
commands.summary: Moves the transient at `from` (seconds in the file, as `clip.transients` lists it) to `to`, as Shift-dragging a pseudo-warp marker does.

commands.label: Move Warp Markers
commands.summary: Moves the warp markers named in `markers` (their place in the map, the first being 0) of each of the warped audio clips `clips`, which must hold files of the same length, by the same number of ticks `by` (negative moves them earlier).

commands.label: Slice to New MIDI Track
commands.summary: Opens the Slice to New MIDI Track dialog for an audio clip (`clip`, or the one audio clip selected in either view).

commands.label: Quantize
commands.summary: Quantises a warped audio clip: for each line of the quantise grid inside the time selection (`from` to `to` in ticks from 1.1.1, or the whole clip with none), the clip's transient nearest that line, if one lies within half a grid step of it, gets a warp marker at its time in the file (made if there is none) and moves `amount` percent of the way to the line, keeping its time in the file.

commands.label: Rename Clip
commands.summary: Renames a clip.

commands.label: Replace Sample
commands.summary: Replaces an audio clip's file with the file at `path`, as dropping a file from the browser on the Clip View does: the clip keeps its gain and pitch, and its warp markers only if the new file is exactly as long as the old one.

commands.label: Reset Transients
commands.summary: Takes away all of an audio clip's transient edits: the transients put in by hand go, and the detected ones that were taken away come back.

commands.label: Reverse Clip
commands.summary: Gives an audio clip a backwards copy of its file: the copy is written through the processed-file writer, and the clip plays it, with its Start and End markers, loop brace and warp markers mirrored about the file, so it plays the same stretch of sound backwards.

commands.label: Reverse Clip
commands.summary: Reverses an audio clip's file: the clip plays `media`, a reversed copy of its file, with its Start and End markers, loop brace and warp markers mirrored about the file, so it plays the same stretch of sound backwards.

commands.label: Save Default Clip
commands.summary: Saves an audio clip's Warp switch, warp markers and tempo, warp mode and mode controls (which hold its Transpose and Detune), and gain as its file's defaults, as the Save button in the clip's title bar does: into a small file of Beatlayer's own, `<sample file name>.beatlayer-clip`, beside the sample, so the defaults travel with it, replacing any saved before.

commands.label: Save Clip as File
commands.summary: Saves a clip from the Arrangement or a Session slot as a clip file (`.blclip`) in `folder` (the User Library's `Clips` folder if left out), as dragging the clip onto a folder in the browser does.

commands.label: Scale Clip Tempo
commands.summary: Multiplies every segment's tempo and the clip's own tempo of a warped audio clip by `factor`: 2 is Live's ×2 and 0.5 its ÷2, which correct a tempo found at half or double.

commands.label: Set 1.1.1 Here
commands.summary: Makes a point of a warped audio clip's file its 1.1.1, the downbeat of its first bar: at the selected warp marker (`marker`, its place in the map, the first being 0) or at the Sample Editor's insert marker (`beat`, ticks from the clip's current 1.1.1, or `time`, seconds in the file); give one of the three.

commands.label: Replace Clip Contents
commands.raised_by_arguments: destructive as well when it would leave a MIDI clip fewer notes than it has, deleting the rest, so it then asks the person first unless you're autonomous; adding notes or keeping their count doesn't; a dry run says which
commands.summary: Replaces what a clip plays: for an audio clip, the audio file it names by content hash with all its settings at once; for a MIDI clip, its whole list of notes.

commands.label: Add Envelope Breakpoint
commands.summary: Sets the value of one of a clip's envelopes at a position, adding a breakpoint there or replacing the one that's there, as clicking or dragging a breakpoint in the Envelopes tab does.

commands.label: Curve Envelope Segment
commands.summary: Curves the segment starting at one of a clip envelope's breakpoints, as holding Alt (Windows) or Option (macOS) while dragging a segment in the Envelopes tab does.

commands.label: Link Envelope
commands.summary: Switches a clip envelope's Linked switch: linked (`true`, the default), it follows the clip's region and loop, playing what the clip's contents play; unlinked, it plays once from the clip's start, one tick per tick, for as long as the clip lasts.

commands.label: Set Clip Fades
commands.summary: Sets the lengths, in seconds, of an audio clip's fade-in, from silence at the clip's start in the arrangement, and its fade-out, to silence at its end; 0 is no fade.

commands.label: Set Clip Follow Actions
commands.summary: Changes a Session clip's follow actions, as the Launch Properties panel does (`clip` is the ID of a clip that sits in a slot).

commands.label: Set Clip Gain
commands.summary: Sets an audio clip's gain as a linear gain: 1 is 0 dB (where every clip starts), 0.5 is about -6 dB (10^(dB/20) converts decibels), 2 is about +6 dB, and 0 is silence (-inf dB).

commands.label: Set Clip Groove
commands.summary: Sets the Clip Groove of MIDI or audio clips to a groove of the Groove Pool (`groove`), or to none when `groove` is left out.

commands.label: Set Clip High Quality
commands.summary: Switches an audio clip's high-quality interpolation (`data.audio.high_quality`, on for a new clip).

commands.label: Set Clip Launch Mode
commands.summary: Sets what a press and a release of a Session clip's launch button do (a clip that sits in a slot; `clip` is its ID): `trigger` (the default) starts the clip on the launch grid and it plays on, a second press restarts it; `gate` starts it on a press and stops it on the grid after the release; `toggle` starts it on a press and the next press stops it on the grid; `repeat` starts it on a press and restarts it every launch quantisation step while the press lasts, then stops it on the grid after the release.

commands.label: Set Clip Launch Quantization
commands.summary: Sets a Session clip's own launch quantisation, the grid its launches wait for: one of the global quantisation's steps (`none`, `8_bars`, `4_bars`, `2_bars`, `1_bar`, `half`, `half_triplet`, `quarter`, `quarter_triplet`, `eighth`, `eighth_triplet`, `sixteenth`, `sixteenth_triplet`, `thirty_second`), or `null` (the default, Live's "Global") to follow the global quantisation.

commands.label: Set Clip Legato
commands.summary: Switches Legato on or off for a Session clip, one that sits in a slot (`clip` is its ID).

commands.label: Resize Clip
commands.summary: Changes how long a clip is, in ticks, keeping its start and its contents.

commands.label: Set Clip Loop
commands.summary: Moves an audio clip's loop brace, in seconds into its audio file for an unwarped clip or in ticks of its contents (`ticks` true) for a warped one (a command in the other form is refused; `end` `null` for the end of the file), as the Clip View's loop Position and Length fields do.

commands.label: Clip Loop On/Off
commands.summary: Switches an audio or MIDI clip's Loop switch on or off, leaving its loop brace where it is.

commands.label: Set MIDI Clip Loop
commands.summary: Moves a MIDI clip's loop brace, in ticks from the clip's beginning (`end` `null` for the end of the clip), as the Clip View's loop Position and Length fields do.

commands.label: Set MIDI Clip Start and End
commands.summary: Moves a MIDI clip's Start and End markers, in ticks from the clip's beginning: the clip starts playing at `start` when the song reaches the clip, and, while its loop is off, plays until `end` (`null` for the end of the clip) or the clip's own end in the arrangement, whichever comes first, then is silent.

commands.label: Activate/Deactivate Clip
commands.summary: Switches a clip's activator: `mute` true deactivates the clip, so it stays in place but doesn't play, and false activates it again.

commands.label: Set Clip Pitch
commands.summary: Sets an audio clip's pitch: `transpose`, in whole semitones from -48 to 48, and `detune`, in cents from -50 to 50 (`data.audio.transpose` and `data.audio.detune`; a new clip has neither).

commands.label: Set Clip RAM Mode
commands.summary: Switches an audio clip's RAM mode (`data.audio.ram`, off for a new clip).

commands.label: Set Clip Start and End
commands.summary: Moves an audio clip's Start and End markers: the clip starts playing at `start` when the song reaches the clip, and, while its loop is off, plays until `end` (`null` for the end of the file) or the clip's own end in the arrangement, whichever comes first, then is silent.

commands.label: Set Clip Scale
commands.summary: Sets a clip's scale: whether its Scale Mode is on (`enabled`), its root note (`root`, 0 is C and 11 is B) and its scale (`name`, one of the names `song.scales` reads).

commands.label: Set Warp Segment BPM
commands.summary: Sets a warped audio clip's BPM field.

commands.label: Switch Lead/Follow
commands.summary: Switches a warped Arrangement clip's Lead/Follow switch (`data.audio.tempo_leader`, off for a new clip).

commands.label: Set Clip Velocity Amount
commands.summary: Sets how much the velocity of the MIDI note that launches a Session clip changes the clip's volume: `amount` is from 0 (no influence, the default) to 1 (100 %, where the softest note plays the clip silently).

commands.label: Clip Warp On/Off
commands.summary: Switches an audio clip's Warp on or off.

commands.label: Set Warp Mode
commands.summary: Sets how a warped audio clip's audio is fitted to the speed its warp map sets: `beats`, `tones`, `texture`, `re_pitch`, `complex` or `complex_pro` (`data.audio.warp_mode`; a new clip is `beats`).

commands.label: Set Warp Settings
commands.summary: Sets controls of an audio clip's warp modes, named by mode, any of them in one undo step (`data.audio.warp_settings`; a control at its default isn't listed there).

commands.label: Shift Warp Marker
commands.summary: Moves the time in the file of warp marker `marker` (its place in the map, the first being 0) of each of the warped audio clips `clips`, which must hold files of the same length, by `by` seconds (negative moves it earlier), keeping its beat: the waveform moves under the marker.

commands.label: Slice to New MIDI Track
commands.summary: Cuts an audio clip into slices on a new MIDI track.

commands.label: Slide Clip Contents
commands.summary: Slides a warped audio clip's contents inside the clip, which stays where it is and keeps its length: `by` is how far the contents move in ticks, positive later.

commands.label: Stretch Clip
commands.summary: Stretches a warped audio clip so its dragged `edge` (left or right) lands on the tick `at`, the other edge staying put.

commands.label: Clip Transients
commands.summary: Lists an audio clip's transients: where its file starts notes and hits, found once in the background and kept by the file's content hash, with the clip's own edits applied (`clip.insert_transient`, `clip.delete_transients`, `clip.move_transient`, `clip.reset_transients`).

commands.label: Trim Clip Start
commands.summary: Moves a clip's left edge to `start`, keeping its end and keeping its contents where they play, as dragging the clip's left edge does: a later `start` hides the beginning of the clip, an earlier one shows more of it.

commands.label: Warp as Loop
commands.summary: Warps a warped audio clip's whole file as a loop of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 or 32 bars of 4/4, the number whose tempo is nearest the set's tempo at the clip's start: a warp marker at the start of the file on 1.1.1 and one at its end on the last bar's end, the Start and End markers and the loop brace on the whole file, the loop on, and that tempo as the clip's.

commands.label: Warp From Here
commands.summary: Warps a warped audio clip from a point on: at the selected warp marker (`marker`) or at a new one at the insert marker (`beat` or `time`, as for `clip.set_1_1_1_here`).

commands.label: Warp Selection as Loop
commands.summary: Warps the part of a warped audio clip's file from `from` to `to` (seconds in the file) as a loop of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 or 32 bars of 4/4, the number whose tempo is nearest the set's tempo at the clip's start: a warp marker at each end of the part, the Start and End markers and the loop brace on it, the loop on.
